ReadyHint: Use the menu on the left to manage this device.
AuthHint: Unlock the screen and accept the USB debugging prompt, then scan again.

InstallHint: Choose a single .apk file. If the app is already installed, ADB will attempt an update.

LoadFirst: Load the package list from the active device.

NoBoot: Select an Android, ADB recovery or Fastboot device to use its available controls.

NoScanTools: Use the complete portable folder with its bundled tools.
